meta.name: legacy-modernizer
meta.description: Designs incremental migration strategies, identifies service boundaries, produces dependency maps and migration roadmaps, and generates API facade designs for aging codebases. Use when modernizing legacy systems, implementing strangler fig pattern or branch by abstraction, decomposing monoliths, upgrading frameworks or languages, or reducing technical debt without disrupting business operations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定渐进式迁移策略，分解单体应用，降低技术债务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在维护老旧代码库，需要安全地迁移到新架构
copy.tagline_en: Design incremental migration strategies, decompose monoliths, reduce technical debt
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a legacy codebase and need to safely migrate to a new architecture

howto.what: Claude会先分析旧代码,输出依赖图、风险清单和API门面设计;再制定分阶段、每步可回滚的迁移计划;随后建立覆盖80%以上现有行为的测试作为安全网;用开关逐步切换流量,确认稳定后才删除旧代码。
howto.when: 当用户要求改造遗留系统、拆分单体、升级框架或语言,或进行其他降低技术债的增量改造时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个旧项目的依赖,输出依赖图和风险登记表。
say.note: Claude会先做系统评估,产出评估摘要。

say.text: 为这个单体应用制定增量迁移路线图,每阶段都要有回滚策略。
say.note: Claude会给出分阶段计划和回滚触发条件。

say.text: 用绞杀者模式配合特征开关,逐步把订单服务切到新系统。
say.note: Claude会生成外观层代码和流量切换步骤。

howto.what_en: Assesses legacy code, outputs dependency maps, risk registers, API facade designs; creates phased migration plans with rollback; builds 80%+ coverage tests as safety net; shifts traffic via flags, removes old code after stability.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to modernize a legacy system, decompose a monolith, or upgrade frameworks/languages, or perform other incremental migrations to reduce technical debt.

say_en.text: Assess this legacy codebase's dependencies and risks, output a map and register.
say_en.note: Claude starts with an assessment summary.

say_en.text: Create a phased migration roadmap for this monolith, each with rollback.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a phased plan with rollback triggers.

say_en.text: Use strangler fig and feature flags to slowly shift order traffic to new system.
say_en.note: Claude will generate facade code and traffic-shift steps.
